title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones (TAB-001): dimensions vary by diameter range (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm)
Relief grooves for thread (TAB-002): must be made when thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove geometry defined by pitch P: ranges P ≤1.25, 1.5 ≤ P ≤1.75 ≤2, 2.5 ≤ P ≤3
Specific grooves must be indicated in details on drawing
Standards reference: UNI regulation and TRASMITAL specifications
dimensions: TAB-001 range 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4mm, radius R 1.6, angle 30°
TAB-001 range 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.6mm, radius R 1.6, angle 30°
TAB-001 range 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 1.9mm, radius R 2.5, angle 30°
TAB-001 range >125mm: width 7mm, depth 5.1mm, radius R4.0, angle 30°
inspection: Verify groove dimensions against diameter range specification
Check groove position relative to grinding zone or thread shoulder
Verify angle of 30° for grinding relief grooves
Confirm groove geometry parameters R, A, B, T1, T2 match thread pitch range
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves for grinding zones facilitate grinding wheel clearance
Thread relief grooves required at shoulder intersections with ledge function
Groove depth and width scale with shaft diameter
30° angle standard for grinding relief grooves
Thread relief groove profile includes radius R and specific depths T1, T2
training_guidance: NX agent must select relief groove geometry based on shaft diameter range for grinding zones
For diameters 18-50mm use narrower groove (2.5mm wide, 0.4mm deep)
For diameters >125mm use larger groove (7mm wide, 5.1mm deep)
Thread relief grooves are mandatory when thread ends at functional shoulder
Select thread relief dimensions based on thread pitch P value
Apply 30° approach angle for all grinding relief grooves
Model groove profile with specified radius R and depth parameters
Include groove callout in detail drawings as per standard requirements
Use UNI4386 as reference standard for groove comparison
summary: This page defines two types of relief grooves: grinding zone relief grooves (TAB-001) with geometry varying by shaft diameter (18-50mm up to >125mm), and thread relief grooves (TAB-002) required at shoulder intersections, with dimensions based on thread pitch. All grinding relief grooves use 30° angle, while thread relief grooves specify radius R, width A, depths B/T1/T2 per pitch range. Specific tolerances apply to each diameter range, and grooves must be detailed on drawings.
